overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the transfer-station suspension motion naturally flowed from the posted dissolution topic, so the notice was sufficient.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the committee discussed and voted on a motion to cease transfer station operations at a December 2019 meeting, a topic not listed on the notice.
allegations.key_passage: We find that the motion regarding the suspension of the transfer stations naturally flowed from the Committee’s consideration of the posted agenda topic, which notified the public that the Committee planned to discuss dissolution of the District.
